status.noTemplate: no template: waits for a whole view document

hint.tiles: What msg.payload may be for each tile of the view; msg.topic is the tile ID. Every tile also takes an object of fields, e.g. {"value": 79.3, "status": "warning"}; null removes one.
hint.noTemplate: The view has no template, so its tiles are unknown here. Import the template in the view; without one, the node only takes a whole view document.
hint.example: Adds an inject and a function node in front of this node that send an example value to every tile every 30 s; every other form of each tile is there too, commented out.

example.done: Example flow inserted to the left of this node. Deploy to send it.

append.effect: is appended to the series, at the time it arrives

appendAt.effect: is appended at that time, in milliseconds or ISO 8601

appendTo.effect: is appended to the series of that name

pairs.effect: replaces the series; msg.series picks which

steps.effect: replaces every series: a point every stepSec from start, in UTC

values.payload: an array of numbers, one per category

valuesTo.payload: an array of numbers with msg.series
valuesTo.effect: replaces the values of the series of that name

categories.effect: replaces the categories and their values together

statuses.effect: a verdict per bar: ok, warning, critical or null

rows.payload: an array of rows, each an array of cells

rowStatus.effect: replaces the rows, with a status per row

state.effect: starts a new segment, at the time it arrives

stateAt.effect: starts the segment at that time

stateLane.effect: starts a segment in the lane of that name

window.effect: moves the time axis; what lies before from is trimmed
